package player

import (
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest/entitytimer"
	"time"
)

const TimerBuff int32 = 1
const TimerRevive int32 = 2

func (component *TimerComponent) registerTimerHandlers(handlers *entitytimer.Handlers) {
	handlers.Register(TimerRevive, func(f entitytimer.Fire) time.Duration {
		dao := component.owner.Dao()
		if dao.GetReviveTimer() == f.ID {
			dao.SetHP(100)
			dao.SetReviveTimer(0)
		}
		return 0
	})
	handlers.Register(TimerBuff, func(f entitytimer.Fire) time.Duration {
		// ID 防止已被替换的到期事件清除新 Buff；加载后补触发同样只清理自己的状态。
		dao := component.owner.Dao()
		if dao.GetBuffTimer() == f.ID {
			dao.SetBuffValue(0)
			dao.SetBuffTimer(0)
		}
		return 0
	})
}
